Name: T's Recessed Fish Tank (Formerly Recessed Fish Tank (SDV1.6))
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Important Notice for Existing Users (Updating to v2.0)[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Starting with version 2.0, the mod's UniqueID, name, and file structure have changed. The mod now uses Content Patcher and T's Core instead of Furniture Framework.
If you're updating from a version earlier than 2.0, please delete the old "[b]Recessed Fish Tank (SDV1.6)[/b]" folder before installing the new version.
The item IDs for all fish tanks, Long Pillars, and catalogs have also changed in version 2.0. However, items from previous versions that are already placed in the game or stored in your inventory or chests will be automatically migrated to the new IDs. Fish and decorations inside fish tanks will also be preserved.
Please note that previous furniture styles and colors are not automatically restored during migration. You can change them again using the new customization controls.
During this process, you may see ID migration messages in your SMAPI log. [b]These are normal informational messages, not errors.[/b]
Once the migration is complete, save your game. The migration messages will no longer appear when you load that save again.[/size][/quote]
[size=6][color=#ffff00][b]T's Recessed Fish Tank[/b][/color][/size]
Add a variety of recessed fish tanks designed to blend naturally with your farmhouse interior!
Choose from different tank sizes, styles, and frame colors, and combine them with Long Pillars to create your own aquarium-themed rooms.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]
[b]Recessed Fish Tanks in 8 Sizes[/b]
Adds recessed fish tanks in eight different widths (measured in tiles):
- Width 3
- Width 7
- Width 9
- Width 10
- Width 11
- Width 12
- Width 13
- Width 17
These sizes are designed to fit various rooms in the farmhouse and Ginger Island farmhouse without leaving gaps.

[b]Customizable Fish Tank Styles[/b]
Each recessed fish tank has four available styles:
- Tall
- Tall (No Background)
- Short
- Short (No Background)
You can also choose from 10 frame colors, including colors designed to match popular recolor mods.

[b]Transparent Fish Tank[/b]
Adds a completely transparent fish tank with two selectable fish areas: Tall (3 Tiles) and Short (1 Tile).
Use it to create unique aquarium displays or experiment with creative furniture arrangements.
Be careful, though: without any fish inside, you might forget where you placed it!

[b]Customizable Long Pillars[/b]
Adds Long Pillars that can be combined with recessed fish tanks to fill gaps on either side, overlapped with standard pillars to make ceilings appear higher, or used in other furniture arrangements.
Long Pillars are available in 10 colors and nine decoration styles, including potted plants and decorative banners.

[b]Easy Furniture Customization[/b]
Use the following controls during furniture placement preview:
- Right-click: Change furniture type or style.
- Shift + Right-click: Change furniture color.
- Shift + Space: Reset furniture variants to their defaults.
The modifier keys can be customized through T's Core's GMCM settings.
Optional notifications display the currently selected type or color when switching variants.

[b]Recessed Fish Tank Catalog[/b]
Purchase the dedicated Recessed Fish Tank Catalog from Willy's shop to access all available fish tanks and Long Pillars.
The catalog itself features 12 selectable appearances based on vanilla table designs.
You can also purchase selected fish tanks and Long Pillars directly from Willy's shop.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/color][/size]
Customize the mod through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].
- Enable or disable furniture sales at Willy's shop.
- Choose which furniture items appear in the dedicated catalog.
- Adjust the catalog price.
- Make the dedicated catalog available from the vanilla Furniture Catalogue.
- Display tank widths on furniture icons, with a choice of bottom-left or center positioning.
- Enable or disable type and color change notifications.
- Enable or disable fish tank lighting.
- Adjust the capacity of each fish tank separately for swimming creatures, bottom dwellers, and decorations.
- Adjust texture saturation to better match recolor mods.
Hiding furniture from the catalog does not affect items you already own or have placed.
The dedicated catalog remains available at Willy's shop even when individual furniture sales are disabled.
[b]Note:[/b] When adjusting fish tank capacities, it is recommended not to overcrowd tanks relative to their size to avoid visual issues.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] 2.1.0 or later[/size]
Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is optional but recommended for changing settings in-game.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Languages[/b][/color][/size]
Currently supports English, Japanese, and Korean.
